newsitem.title: USA: Ciena sees Q3 shr in $0.31 to $0.33 range.
newsitem.headline: Ciena sees Q3 shr in $0.31 to $0.33 range.

text.p: Ciena Corp said on Wednesday that it expects earnings per share for the third quarter of 1997 to come in between $0.31 and $0.33 per share, compared to $0.10 per share for the third quarter of 1996.
The company's projection surpassed analysts' estimates, which, according to First Call consensus figures, put the company's third quarter earnings at $0.27 per share.

The company cautioned, however, that while Ciena did not see a slowdown in customer spending last year, investors should not be surprised to see moderating sequential growth for the company in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 and the first quarter of fiscal 1998.
"We remain comfortable with current consensus expectations for the balance of fiscal year 1997 and are very positive about our prospects for 1998," said company president Patrick Nettles.
First Call put Ciena's annual earnings for 1997 at $0.96 per share.
The company, which makes multiplexing systems for long distance telecom systems, expects to report financial results for the third quarter after the market close on August 20.
